BULL.title: Webull Corporation Class Action Lawsuit Seeks Recovery for Investors; December 7 2026, Deadline - Contact Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, LLP
BULL.claim: A securities fraud class action lawsuit has been filed against Webull Corporation (NASDAQ: BULL) alleging material misstatements regarding the company's relationship with China. The lawsuit covers investors who purchased securities between April 26, 2025 and October 6, 2026. The stock fell approximately 19% on October 7, 2026, after a Select Committee report revealed that Webull's operations, ownership, and compliance infrastructure are heavily tied to China, contradicting the company's representations as an American company.
